statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); git_branch=$(cd "$cwd" && git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo 'no-git'); printf '\033[2m%s@%s\033[0m:\033[2m%s\033[0m \033[2m(%s)\033[0m \033[2m[%s]\033[0m' "$(whoami)" "$(hostname -s)" "$(basename "$cwd")" "$git_branch" "$model"
